origin.description: Lorenz curve of the exponential distribution, which has no free parameter.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Population shares in the unit interval.

origin.details: The ordinate is built from the reciprocal of one minus the share, then from the logarithm of that reciprocal. The share 1 is left undefined. The function has class theorLc.

translation.description: Lorenz curve of the exponential distribution, which has no free parameter.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Population shares in the unit interval, as a scalar or an array.

translation.details: The same three arithmetic steps as the R function are used, so the share 1 stays undefined. Other shares follow p + (1 - p) log(1 - p). The result keeps the shape of p.
translation.value: Lorenz ordinates at p, as a NumPy array of the same shape.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from ineq.theor import lc_exp

p = np.arange(1, 11) / 10
print(lc_exp(p))
